text: 据美联社15日报道，美国政府正从欧洲和中东国家撤回数千万美元的军事援助资金，转而支持部分中南美洲国家。报道说，美国国务院当天通知国会，将把原定提供给斯洛伐克、北马其顿、突尼斯和伊拉克的5200万美元“外国军事融资”，调拨给巴拿马、秘鲁、厄瓜多尔和哥伦比亚。美政府“外国军事融资”项目以赠款或贷款形式提供融资，供受援国采购美国军事装备和相关服务。（新华社）
text_en: According to an Associated Press report on the 15th, the U.S. government is withdrawing tens of millions of dollars in military aid funds from European and Middle Eastern countries and redirecting them to support some Central and South American countries. The report said the U.S. State Department notified Congress that day that it would reallocate $52 million in "Foreign Military Financing" originally intended for Slovakia, North Macedonia, Tunisia and Iraq to Panama, Peru, Ecuador and Colombia. The U.S. government's "Foreign Military Financing" program provides financing in the form of grants or loans for recipient countries to purchase American military equipment and related services. (Xinhua News Agency)
